_comment: Manually authored per-image, per-variant layout. Every crop and text position here was chosen by gridding/cropping that specific photo and measuring its actual negative space and product/model boundaries — nothing is computed by the renderer. `crop` is {x,y,width,height} in the ORIGINAL MASTER's pixel coordinates (a lossless sharp .extract(), never a resize/distort — width/height are always exactly 4:5). All other coordinates (textBox, supportPosition, dividerPosition, brandPosition) are in the CROPPED canvas's own coordinates (top-left of the crop = 0,0), since that crop is the actual output canvas. A variant may set headlineLinesOverride/accentLineIndexOverride to test a different line-break of the SAME assigned copy from copy.json (not different words).

MOL_IMG_001._photo_notes: REVISED round 2: round-1 variants kept the crop's right edge at the original x1122 the whole time because the product's right boundary was mismeasured (assumed ~x1090-1100). Re-measured precisely this round: the socks actually end at x~1005. That freed ~85-90px of previously-unused margin on the right — this round's 'product still too small' fix comes from trimming the crop's right edge down to x1035-1090 (25-55px of real margin past the sock, not 120px of empty rug/table it had before). Text zone is the same out-of-focus curtain strip at top-right, now measured against each variant's own (tighter) right edge, which is why headline size shrinks a bit as the crop tightens (V1 69px -> V3 56px): trading zone width for product prominence, which is what was asked for.

MOL_IMG_005._photo_notes: REVISED round 5 — same photo, same crop, headline re-broken to 4 lines ('Self-care'/'doesn't'/'need a'/'timeout.') and every element re-measured against a full pixel-grid pass of the master (not eyeballed), because round 4's request to move the whole composition to the 'upper-left clean wall' turned out not to be physically possible: an objective largest-clean-rectangle scan (color-distance from confirmed wall pixels) of x0-650,y0-650 found the biggest pocket clearing the picture frame, potted plant, jar shelf, utensil canister/cutting boards/lemon bowl, and the model's head/hair is either ~391x51px or ~140x71px — neither tall enough for a 4-line headline at any legible size. The only run in this whole photo with both enough width and height is the lower cabinet-front strip used in rounds 3-4, confirmed with the user before proceeding. Within that strip: the model's hip/pants/leg edge is NOT confined to the y700-730 pinch (~x360) as previously documented — it runs continuously down the whole crop, sitting at roughly x360-400 all the way from y~630 to past y1190 (it's her leg, not just her hip), which the first render of this round missed and produced a support line overlapping her pants. Headline: the 4 shorter lines are each individually narrower than round 4's 'doesn't need', so the same ~x355 right-edge budget now allows a much bigger 72px font (up from 51px), widest line 'Self-care' at 280.5px, ~25px clear of the leg. Support: at the required 28px-minimum, 'Wear MOLOSOC while life keeps moving.' measures 546.8px as one line — far too wide to fit left of her leg at any y — so it's wrapped (supportLinesOverride, same rule as headline overrides: reconstructs the exact copy.json sentence, never different words) to 'Wear MOLOSOC' / 'while life' / 'keeps moving.', widest line only 223.3px, comfortably clear. The dark shadowed toe-kick recess under the cabinet (~y1000-1060, RGB brightness ~30-65) sits right where this 3-line support block now starts, but there's no cleaner alternative band before the rug (~y1150) and the actual MOLOSOC socks (confirmed by precise crop: ankle visible from ~y1190, white sock fabric from ~y1230-1250) — the whole support/divider/brand block ends at y1190.4, still 40+px clear of the socks. REVISED round 6: whole block nudged up (headline top 630->615, clear of the lemon bowl which was re-checked and only reaches down to ~y590) and every size stepped up slightly — headline 72->74, support 28->32, wordmark 24->27 — spacing between elements kept the same proportions. Re-verified: widest headline line 'Self-care' at 74px is 288.3px, still ~17px clear of the leg edge; support/divider/brand (now ending y~1201) still ~30px clear of the socks (~y1230).

MOL_IMG_019._photo_notes: Approved as-is this round — unchanged from the prior round. Standing, watering plants. Head ~y40, product (socks) ~x530-870,y1150-1300. Crop trims only the right side (chair/window); the large plain-wall zone top-left (x55-485,y55+) is untouched by the trim, so text layout is identical across variants — the variation here is purely crop tightness/product prominence.
